item.title: Social media and cultural taste sparks demand for exotic fruits
item.description: Tropical fruits previously rare to Far North Queensland are finding a booming customer base in capital cities as retailers stock more of the unusual produce. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Perth artist paints Parkinson's as monster in solo exhibit
item.description: Andrew Grero, 40, who was diagnosed with young-onset Parkinson's disease four years ago, aims to explain how it affects those living with it through his colourful artworks. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sydney suburban football pitch upgrade soars to $24m
item.description: It was meant to cost $3.3 million to turn Norman Griffiths Oval into a synthetic field, but a new report has suggested another seven-figure budget increase for what critics say is Australia's most expensive football pitch. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Safety fears after plane's near miss with drone photographing canola crop
item.description: Blooming canola is a drone photographer's delight, but reports of potentially fatal near misses with aircraft have prompted a warning for operators. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: ASIO chief says media, politicians should have done more to call out antisemitism
item.description: Mike Burgess tells a podcast that he, media and politicians should have done more to call out antisemitism following the October 7 attacks. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Lifesaving Central Queensland rescue services to go to tender
item.description: The state government is seeking a single operator to tender for the operation of two aeromedical services in central Queensland. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: AUKUS architects say pact on track at five-year mark, but facing challenges
item.description: Five years after the pact between Australia, the US, and the UK was announced, three of its key architects assess its progress toward its goals, including arming Australia with nuclear-powered submarines to deter Chinese aggression in the Indo-Pacific. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Brad Ryan

item.title: From African shepherd to Australia's marathon record holder
item.description: Australian long-distance runner, Haftu Strintzos, shares his "double life" from being a barefoot shepherd in Ethiopia to claiming the national marathon record on just his fourth attempt. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Damien Peck

item.title: Liberal Party grapples with promoting Alex Antic at high-stakes AGM
item.description: In a ballot that will have implications in Canberra, the South Australian Liberal Party is set to decide whether its future lies with the controversial right-wing senator. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Kelsall

item.title: A Sydney council's crackdown on smart glasses amid 'growing anger'
item.description: Canterbury-Bankstown is the first Sydney council to introduce a blanket ban on smart glasses, following similar action by local governments in Queensland and Victoria. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Miriah Davis

item.title: Russia’s plans may include strikes against Ukraine’s allies, Poland says
item.description: In a speech to the Polish parliament, Donald Tusk says there is a "real risk" that Russian drones may fall on "the territory of one or several NATO countries on the eastern flank" and call it an accident. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: 'A dream come true': Walton's unconventional road to professional tennis
item.description: Adam Walton's path to professional tennis began far from the bright lights of the ATP tour, on courts tucked inside a racetrack in the small Queensland town of Home Hill. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Arianna Levy

item.title: Wilsons Prom's Sealers Cove track reopens after five years
item.description: The road to repair Sealer's Cove is a tale straight from the pages of Swiss Family Robinson and includes helicopters, barges, and a temporary camp and mess hall created to get the job done. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Stuchbery

item.title: Drug drivers will face higher fines under new Queensland laws
item.description: Drink and drug drivers will face higher penalties under new laws passed in Queensland parliament. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Richards

item.title: How Swans rebuilt their midfield to challenge for premiership
item.description: Instead of star power, the Swans are relying on structure and balance to drive them deeper into the finals. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sean Lawson and Cody Atkinson

item.title: Victorian TAFE teachers working seven unpaid hours on average each week
item.description: A new report has found Victoria's TAFE system receives the lowest "per hour" funding in the country, prompting fears the growing state will fail to meet critical skills requirements. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sacha Payne

item.title: Charles 'giddily elated' on night Diana was killed, her brother claims
item.description: Princess Diana's brother has accused King Charles III of sounding "giddily elated, like a lottery winner" on the night his ex-wife was killed in a car crash almost three decades ago. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Riley Stuart

item.title: Shirt brand owner shares fix to get thousands of Temu dupes taken down
item.description: Warwick Levy spent hours trying to get his brand's T-shirt designs removed from Temu as its reporting platform kept crashing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Liana Walker

item.title: These tiny crocodiles may be at risk, but they can't be listed as 'threatened'
item.description: The Northern Territory's tiny crocs are freshwater crocodiles not a separate species. Despite this, some scientists think the crocs are unique and need special protection. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Peter de Kruijff

item.title: Why Australia has a 'fuel costs crisis' not a fuel supply crisis when it comes to diesel
item.description: The "crack spread", or profit margin, on diesel is increasing as refiners capitalise on the Middle East conflict, and it's hurting the slim margins of Australia's farmers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Researchers who analysed 10,000 crashes say car size does matter
item.description: A study of 13 years of crashes in Australia finds a link between car height and risk of pedestrian death, particularly for women and children. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Labor pounces on migration problems, but leaves massive wedge for critics
item.description: After the embarrassment of having to abort his earlier press club appearance, Tony Burke produced a package that, on his own admission, did not contain all he'd wished. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
